storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dark place; whole cloves keep their aroma for a long time.
looksLike: Dark brown, nail-shaped buds about 1-1.5 cm long with a round head; a strong, numbing aroma.
howToPick: General guidance, not from a source in this run: whole dark-brown buds with the round head intact and a strong smell. Avoid buds that are crumbly, pale or that smell weak (oil may have been removed).
shelfLife: About 1-2 years whole in a sealed pack (general guidance).

usedIn.raw: 2 buds per serving (1 in the rice water, 1 in the masala)
